facts.fact: 离开纽约后坐了将近三天的火车，抵达怀俄明州的夏延（Cheyenne）
facts.anchor: After almost three days of travel, we’d arrived in Cheyenne.

facts.fact: 夏延不是终点，余下的路程改用马匹走
facts.anchor: The rest of the journey would be made on horseback.

facts.fact: Zane 自述少年时代大半在街上混：先做擦鞋童、报童、剥牡蛎工，之后才进 Grey 糖厂做工
facts.anchor: Most of my youth had been spent on the streets—as a bootblack, a newsie, then an oyster shucker—before I went to work in the sugar mill.

facts.fact: 同行的两人：站台上搬行李的搬运工 Sam，以及一路随行的调查员 Cribbs
facts.anchor: I hadn’t left my compartment, but between Sam and Cribbs, who came along with me on this journey, I’d wanted for nothing.

facts.fact: 从夏延到 Orson 的营地还要至少骑两天
facts.anchor: At least two days of riding to reach their camp.

facts.fact: 为不惊动 Orson，他们正经组织了一次狩猎出行作掩护，营里的人只会以为他们也是来加入的猎手
facts.anchor: We’d organized a real trip so as to not raise any alarm bells with Orson, and these men would assume we were more hunters coming to join the party.

facts.fact: Zane 拒绝留在营地等 Orson 回来，坚持要单独去找他
facts.anchor: I need to get him alone. And I don’t want to wait.

facts.fact: Zane 逼 Orson 认下婚内出轨、不经审判、不见报地放 Caroline 走
facts.anchor: You will admit to infidelity and let her go.

facts.fact: Zane 以糖厂那场火与他骚扰女职员的旧账威胁 Orson：一旦公开，父亲只能公开不认这个儿子
facts.anchor: I’ll go public with what you did at the mill, how you started that fire.

facts.fact: 枪在手里时 Zane 一度动了在林中悄悄杀掉 Orson 的念头
facts.anchor: No one would ever miss him.
